newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian soybean prices firm on poor arrivals.
newsitem.headline: Indian soybean prices firm on poor arrivals.

text.p: Indian soybean prices firmed on good demand and poor arrivals from processing plants on Tuesday, dealers said.
Soybean prices rose by 100-150 rupees per tonne.
Dealers said soyoil prices fell by 100 rupees per tonne on increased selling from plants and refineries.
Soymeal and rapeseed extraction prices were almost steady but undertone was weak. Soymeal yellow was $270 per tonne in export.

Rapeseed extraction was $132-133 per tonne in export. Rapeseed extraction was 4,500 rupees FOR Bedi Bunder and 4,450-4,475 rupees FOR Bhavnagar. Export demand was weak against limited offerings. Dealers said that prices may further decrease as selling pressure may increase next month.
